CustomField.description: A copy of the Triggering Record ID field, kept so you can find the issues of one record quickly, even with many issues. It is filled on every save with the value exactly as written, a record Id or any other text, and is blank when the source is blank. Issues saved before this field existed may have it blank.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The record that started the failed call, kept so the issue can be found quickly. Filled on every save from Triggering Record ID. May be blank on issues saved before this field existed.
CustomField.label: Triggering Record Index
